scenes.label: Describe
scenes.title: Describe the app in the molecule.dev IDE, the mlcl CLI or any MCP agent, and Synthase assembles it from the open-source @molecule catalog.

scenes.label: Bonds
scenes.title: Every provider sits behind a swappable bond, so changing the database is one import, not a rewrite.

scenes.label: Built in
scenes.title: Auth, payments, i18n, analytics, monitoring, tests and CI come wired in from day one.

scenes.label: Feedback loop
scenes.title: Built-in analytics, error tracking and feedback let the AI keep improving the app from real use.

scenes.label: Outcomes
scenes.title: Faster, cheaper, higher-quality apps for web, mobile and API that stay easy to change.

tiles.label: Auth & OAuth
tiles.info: Sessions, passwords, two-factor and OAuth sign-in — @molecule/api-auth and app-auth.

tiles.label: Payments & billing
tiles.info: Checkout, subscriptions and invoices — @molecule/api-payments, with the provider as a bond.

tiles.label: Database & migrations
tiles.info: A typed data store with migrations; the database engine is a bond behind one interface.

tiles.label: i18n · dozens of languages
tiles.info: Every UI string goes through t(); companion locale packages ship dozens of languages.

tiles.label: Analytics
tiles.info: One tracking interface on both ends; the provider is a bond.

tiles.label: Logging & monitoring
tiles.info: Structured logging, health checks and uptime probes.

tiles.label: Error tracking
tiles.info: Exceptions captured with context on API and app; the tracker is a swappable bond.

tiles.label: Realtime
tiles.info: Live updates over WebSockets or server-sent events behind one interface.

tiles.label: Uploads & media
tiles.info: File uploads to S3-compatible storage or disk, with image handling.

tiles.label: Push notifications
tiles.info: Web push and mobile push through one bond.

tiles.label: Search
tiles.info: Full-text search; the search engine is a bond.

tiles.label: Feature flags
tiles.info: Flags and gradual rollouts, evaluated on both ends.

tiles.label: Tests: unit, E2E
tiles.info: Unit, integration and Playwright end-to-end tests are scaffolded with the app.

tiles.label: CI/CD & deploys
tiles.info: CI workflows for the major git hosts, and one-click deploys from molecule.dev.

tiles.label: Accessibility (a11y)
tiles.info: Semantic components, focus handling and contrast built into the UI kit.

tiles.label: AGENTS.md for AI agents
tiles.info: Every project ships an AGENTS.md that teaches any coding agent its conventions.

outcomes.title: Faster
outcomes.body: Start from a working, tested app. Existing and custom apps gain the same speed by integrating the packages and the architecture.

outcomes.title: Cheaper
outcomes.body: Far fewer tokens: the AI wires tested packages instead of generating the same code again and again.

outcomes.title: Higher quality
outcomes.body: Type-checked, linted and tested. Polished functionality that already covers the unexpected edge cases.

outcomes.title: Easier to maintain & scale
outcomes.body: One consistent, decoupled architecture with tests, migrations, monitoring and docs built in, so the app stays easy to change and grow.
